from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545456/attempts/2b17c2b4a8284089bbeaca60201f4326/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ee978a5b.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row}
    background = max(colors, key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))
    foreground = next(value for value in colors if value != background)
    return [[foreground if value == background else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]
''')
print(p.read_text())
